notes: THERE AND BACK AGAIN: a new Arcade cabinet - MORDOR FUN RUN. Run the Shire-to-Mordor road, 1000 moose of it, fighting goblins, wolves, spiders and orcs in real time. The run saves itself: leave mid-run and resume at the exact spot, faints return you to the last moose marker, and finishing earns a Trophy Case row.
